engine.label: 02 — Engine & open brain
engine.title: And it shows you why.
engine.body: Every morning at 05:30 the engine reads your <heart>HRV</heart>, your <mind>sleep</mind>, last session's <body>RPE</body> and your latest form checks. It adjusts today's session — or doesn't — and shows the whole chain behind the call: raw signals → rule → AI refinement → action → outcome. Munk sees the escalation before you do. It's one body-map, not four dashboards.
engine.bullet1: Top-set reduction, accessory cut, exercise swap — or no_change. Never more than one change per session.
engine.bullet2: HRV very_low → session paused, mobility + walk, Munk gets notified
engine.bullet3: 30 days of history with counterfactual sliders: "What if I'd slept 7h?" — computed live in your browser
engine.bullet4: Reason codes in plain language, and you can always say "keep original" — no black box, nothing happens behind your back

munkMultiplier.label: 03 — Coaching that scales
munkMultiplier.title: One coach. 5× capacity. Still him.
munkMultiplier.body: AI drafts form-check replies, cohort patterns and morning reports — Munk edits in 30 seconds or rewrites. You never get an AI reply without his signature. And when you hit Beast tier, Coach School opens: you learn to answer yourself, with Munk as senior. Form-check, buddy and Coach School sit on the same body-map as the session.
munkMultiplier.bullet1: AI-drafted form-check replies, signed by Munk before they go out
munkMultiplier.bullet2: Cohort patterns: AI spots when 3+ athletes hit the same problem in the same week
munkMultiplier.bullet3: Coach School: lessons → sandbox cases → live members, with safety moderation on everything outgoing
munkMultiplier.bullet4: AI buddy pairing on level, location and timing — plus Reps for your feedback to others, not just your own reps

mind.label: 04 — Mental engine
mind.title: The head, in the equation. Not as an accessory.
mind.body: Real health is physical AND mental. A 60-second <mind>mind-check</mind> daily builds a mental graph parallel to your <heart>HRV</heart>. When mind-checks show strain for 3 days, the Adaptive Engine dials down without waiting for HRV to break — because the head often feels it first. Private journaling, AI coach written for your week, and — when you tier up — crew sharing so you don't go alone.
mind.bullet1: Mind-check × HRV × training — Adaptive Engine fuses all three. No other app does.
mind.bullet2: AI coach writes today's reflection based on your signal — not a generic meditation.
mind.bullet3: Privacy as progression: Lifter private, Athlete unlocks buddy share, Beast unlocks circles. Your journal is always yours.

domainIndex.heading: Four colours. The whole person.
domainIndex.intro: Most apps pick one thing: steps, calories or sleep. We take all four — body, food, heart and mind — because they pull on each other. Each gets a colour, and the colour follows you all the way in: in the menu, on the cards, in the graphs. The base stays black and white; colour means one thing only — where in your health you are.

faq.heading: Questions?
faq.intro: The things we usually get asked. Missing your answer?

advanced.q: Do I need to be advanced to join?
advanced.a: No. Onboarding adapts intensity and volume to your level. As a beginner, top sets get capped at RPE 7 and the program builds up carefully. Intermediate and advanced lifters get sharper loads from day 1.

oneRm.q: What if I don't know my 1RM?
oneRm.a: Skip the fields in onboarding. We use sensible defaults based on your level, and your very first session produces data that's used to fine-tune the next week. You don't need to know your 1RM upfront.

cancel.a: Yes. Crew membership can be cancelled directly from the Stripe Customer Portal — it takes effect on your next billing date, and you keep access until then. No lock-in, no clauses.

vacation.q: What happens when Mikael is on vacation?
vacation.a: The AI runs uninterrupted — programs are generated, form checks get instant answers, sets get logged and the crew stays active. Mikael's personal reviews can be delayed up to a week during vacation periods, and we always post it in the feed ahead of time.

responseTime.q: How fast do I get a form check back?
responseTime.a: The AI typically responds within 6-15 seconds. Mikael's personal verification lands within 24 hours on weekdays, and you get both an in-app notification and an email when it's ready.

pause.q: Can I pause for travel, illness or injury?
pause.a: Yes. You can pause your active program right in the app — sessions and weekly progression freeze. When you resume, the next week regenerates automatically so you're not fighting stale targets. To pause the subscription, use the Stripe Customer Portal.

irl.q: Is this a replacement for in-person training IRL?
irl.a: For 95% of lifters: yes. AI form check + weekly coach review catches most of it. For those who want more — the 1:1 add-on gives you direct Signal access to Mikael and a weekly 30-min video session. Limited to 8 spots at a time.

cheaper.a: Closed beta is invite-only, and the public price is not locked yet. Join the waitlist — we write when a spot opens. Already have a code? Sign in.

wearables.q: Which wearables does the HRV module support?
wearables.a: WHOOP, Oura and Polar (H10 and the O20 series) are live. You connect via OAuth from settings. We never store your login details, only tokens encrypted at rest. Apple Watch support ships with the MakeIt iPhone app. Garmin is on the roadmap, but not in v1.

hrvScore.q: Why don't I get an HRV score from 0 to 100?
hrvScore.a: Because a number from 0 to 100 promises a precision that doesn't exist. We show your actual RMSSD in milliseconds, your own 60-day baseline band and a 5-bucket readiness ladder, so you see where you sit relative to your own normal, not a made-up scale. You also can't compare your HRV with other people's; healthy RMSSD ranges from roughly 10 to 200 ms depending on age, sex and shape.

hrvPrivacy.q: Who sees my HRV data and lifestyle logs?
hrvPrivacy.a: You by default. Coach sharing is a toggle in the HRV settings — flip it on and Mikael can see your readings, lifestyle tags and weekly insights, and his red-flag queue only triggers on opted-in members. Flip it off and the HRV module runs quietly for you alone. We never pass your wearable data on.

dataDirection.q: Do you push my data back to WHOOP, Oura or Polar?
dataDirection.a: No. Data flows one way only — from your wearable into MakeIt. We never write to their APIs, never share with third parties, and OAuth tokens are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM). You can disconnect from the HRV settings at any time — the tokens are wiped immediately.

weeklyInsight.q: What is the weekly HRV insight?
weeklyInsight.a: Every Sunday evening we correlate your week's RMSSD against your lifestyle tags (sleep, alcohol, stress, illness) and send one short observation — in Danish, never diagnoses, never made-up numbers. Example: 'Sleeping under 7h for three nights drags RMSSD down by ~8%.' The full history lives at /hrv/insights.

openBrainWhy.q: Why do you show the engine publicly?
openBrainWhy.a: Because trust is built on transparency. Our rule layer is 300 lines of pure TypeScript that we show you right here on the landing page — drag the sliders and watch what it would have chosen. Competitors can copy the rules in a day; they cannot copy 6 months of audit logs, baselines, and Munk-in-the-loop UX. The moat is the flywheel, not a secret API.

coCoach.a: A co-coach is a Beast-tier member (5,000+ Reps) Munk has chosen to help with form-check replies and HRV escalations. You start in Coach School: curated lessons, sandbox cases you practice on, and — if you hit 80% agreement with Munk over 50 cases — you're promoted to live with 2-3 assigned members. Munk co-signs everything. You're his lieutenants, not an independent operator.

hrvSharing.q: Do you send my HRV to Munk?
hrvSharing.a: Only if you ask us to. Coach sharing is an explicit toggle in the HRV settings — turn it on and Munk can see your readings, lifestyle tags, and weekly insights (the red-flag queue only triggers on opted-in members). Turn it off and the HRV module runs for you alone. We never send your data to third parties.

optOutAdaptive.q: What if I don't want AI adjustments?
optOutAdaptive.a: You always have control. You can disable adaptive adjustments from the HRV settings (the program then runs as planned without daily tweaks), and even with them on you can reject each individual adjustment with 'Keep original' directly in the session. The engine is an opinion, not a command.

offPlanNutrition.q: What do I do if I eat something that's not in the meal plan?
offPlanNutrition.a: Tap 'I ate something else' in the Nutrition feed, briefly describe what you ate, and it's logged as an off-plan meal. No penalty, no scolding — just data. The coach sees it in weekly signals so next week's planning gets more realistic instead of ignoring reality.
